decisions.reason: A same-message MODIFY already fully records the reference-rendering aesthetic for both the machine and support base, including the required component scope.
The base finish already requires an exact match to the supplied reference; the broad aesthetic instruction does not establish a new color or finish value.
The aesthetic-reference decision does not change the base's clearance purpose, height, supported cup size, or footprint alignment.
The machine color scheme already refers to the colors shown in the CAD renderings, and the source provides no new color or finish specification.
The controls already have rendering-based appearance requirements; the source does not necessarily alter any specific control label, marking, color, or styling attribute.
The spout already must match the supplied rendering as closely as possible, and the source does not change its material, fabrication method, or appearance reference.
The broad aesthetic instruction does not revoke the previously established explicit placard placement, orientation, or two-sided wording requirements.
Aesthetic reproduction of the renderings does not change the machine's structural support or operational-stability requirements.
Rendering-inspired decorative and bowl lighting is already required, and the source does not change the selected compatibility criterion or lighting behavior.
The broad rendering-reference instruction does not necessarily change or remove the explicit cursive E markings and beige lettering requirements.
The aesthetic decision does not affect cleaning access, sanitation, liquid-trap prevention, or spout-cleaning behavior.
The source concerns visual reproduction and does not change whisk length, depth, foam performance, or splash-control positioning.
